name: com.aurix.voice
description: Native AURX/UDP voice client for Aurix Voice Platform: WebSocket control plane, HMAC-authenticated media, jitter buffer and Unity microphone/playback components.

samples.description: IOpusCodec implementation using the pure-C# Concentus library.

Scene + MonoBehaviour: connect with a player token, join a channel, roster with speaking/energy, mute and push-to-talk, network quality bars and client stats, reconnect, chat. Requires the Concentus sample.
